subject: School Security Recommendations and Superintendent Search Finalists
overview: The committee reviewed fifteen school security recommendations, heard several departmental pre-budget reports, and narrowed the superintendent search to two finalists.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the March 19, 2018 meeting, bills, and payrolls.

items.title: Secretary's Report
items.summary: Accepted reports on local Elks scholarships and March expenditures, which included an update on the operational status of Bistro 489.

items.title: Buildings and Grounds Subcommittee Report and Security Study
items.summary: Reviewed 15 security proposals ranging from door numbering to keyless entry and approved a foot traffic study to optimize security monitor placement at high school and vocational entrances.

items.title: Scholastic Art and Writing Awards
items.summary: The committee recognized ten students for their regional and national achievements in the Scholastic Art and Writing competitions.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Minutes and Superintendent Finalists
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the March 29 meeting, voted to require bi-annual payroll reports, and announced Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent and Mr. Thomas Martellone as the two finalists for the superintendent position.

items.title: Bullying and Social Media Discussion
items.summary: Referred a request for updated cyberbullying policies and parent education to a future Committee of the Whole meeting to be held after the superintendent search concludes.

items.title: Professional Development and ALICE Feedback
items.summary: Accepted a report on teacher feedback following initial training on the ALICE security protocol.

items.title: Pre-Budget Reports: ELA, Social Studies, and Science
items.summary: Heard funding requests for curriculum frameworks and a chemistry teacher; the Science Department recommended continuing to pilot the FOSS program while rejecting a literacy-based alternative.

items.title: Pre-Budget Report: Health Services
items.summary: The Director of Health Services requested a 0.5 FTE increase to provide daily nursing coverage at the Curtis-Tufts school and reported on substance abuse screening data.

items.title: After School Program Capacity
items.summary: The administration reviewed waitlists and staffing challenges at the Brooks and Columbus after-school programs, noting that recruitment is ongoing for the fall.
